## QuickView v6.62.4.0 (Pre-release)

> Changelog since `v6.61.0.2`

### What's New & Fixed

- **Built-in Interactive OCR (`#318`)**:
  - Added interactive OCR text selection, drag-select highlight, copy, and select-all overlay (`WinOcrBackend` with sliding-window auto-tiling for oversized images, PDFs, archives, SVG, and WebView frames).
  - Dedicated OCR mode toolbar with auto-pinning, custom `SelectAll` vector icon, hotkey/mouse gesture binding (`OcrText`), and `Alt+O` system menu beep suppression.
- **New Analyzer Plugin: PP-OCRv5 NCNN Vulkan (`com.quickview.ocr.ppocr_ncnn` v0.2.1)**:
  - High-accuracy offline multilingual OCR powered by NCNN + Vulkan GPU (with automatic multi-threaded CPU fallback).
  - One-click curated PP-OCRv5 Mobile model packs: CJK+EN+JP (`ppocrv5_cjk_en`), Latin (`ppocrv5_latin`), Cyrillic (`ppocrv5_eslav`), and Korean (`ppocrv5_korean`), plus zero-hardcoding custom model discovery in `models/`.
  - Aligned DBNet `unclip_ratio` default to `1.50` and added CTC Voronoi token highlight expansion + live OCR re-run on parameter changes.
- **Plugin System & 8-Language Localization (`#320`)**:
  - Fixed plugin download failure in `v6.61.0.x` when manifest `sha256` was omitted (`DownloadPluginPackage` now verifies SHA-256 when provided and validates ZIP integrity via HTTPS), and updated CI to auto-populate `sha256_amd64` / `sha256_arm64` on release.
  - Synchronized host UI language to all plugins at startup and on language switch; expanded `ocr_ppocr_ncnn`, `sr_ncnn_vulkan`, and `qv_shell_thumb` to full 8-language support (`en-US`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja-JP`, `ru-RU`, `de-DE`, `es-ES`, `fr-FR`).
  - Fixed Settings -> Plugins accordion header text overlapping action buttons.
- **Stability & PDF**:
  - Fixed D2D1 multithreaded rendering crash on PDF pages and gallery thumbnail contention (`v6.62.1.0`).

---

### Release Assets & Installation Guide

#### 1. Main Application Packages (`AMD64` = x64, `ARM64` = Windows on ARM)

| File | Type | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `QuickView_Installer_v6.62.4_AMD64.exe` / `_ARM64.exe` | **Standard Installer** | Recommended for regular desktop use (installs to Program Files, registers optional Start Menu / file associations). |
| `QuickView_v6.62.4_AMD64.zip` / `_ARM64.zip` | **Portable Edition** | Extract anywhere and run `QuickView.exe` directly; zero registry pollution. |
| `QuickView_v6.62.4.msixbundle` | **Store / MSIX Bundle** | Unsigned MSIX bundle for sideloading / Store packaging. |

*(Winget / Scoop channels follow official stable releases.)*

#### 2. Optional Plugin Packages

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `sr_ncnn_vulkan_AMD64.zip` / `_ARM64.zip` | **AI Super-Resolution** (`Real-ESRGAN NCNN Vulkan`) — GPU-accelerated 2x/3x/4x image upscaling. |
| `ocr_ppocr_ncnn_AMD64.zip` / `_ARM64.zip` | **Offline Multilingual OCR** (`PP-OCRv5 NCNN Vulkan`) — high-accuracy offline text detection & recognition. |
| `qv_shell_thumb_AMD64.zip` / `_ARM64.zip` | **Windows Explorer Thumbnails** — fast Explorer previews for JXL, AVIF, SVG, PSD, EXR, RAW, CBZ/CBR, and PDF. |

#### 3. Online vs. Offline Plugin & Model Installation

- **Online (Recommended)**: Open **Settings (` , `) -> Plugins -> Marketplace** inside QuickView to install/update plugins and download AI/OCR models with one click — no manual file copying needed.
- **Offline / No-Internet Environment**: Download the desired plugin `.zip` from the assets above and follow the included `README.md` inside each archive:
  - **Portable build**: extract into `<QuickView>\plugins\<category>\<plugin_name>\` (e.g. `plugins\ocr\ocr_ppocr_ncnn\`).
  - **Installer build (Program Files)**: extract into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\QuickView\plugins\<category>\<plugin_name>\`.
  - For SR / OCR models offline, click **Open Model Folder** on the plugin card in Settings and place the model files into that `models\` folder.

---
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/justnullname/QuickView/compare/v6.61.0.2...v6.62.4.0
